+#!/usr/bin/env zsh
+# Catppuccin Mocha colors for fzf. Pinned: fzf reads FZF_DEFAULT_OPTS at
+# invocation, so an in-shell flip would still leave running shells stale.
+export FZF_DEFAULT_OPTS=" \
+--color=bg+:#313244,bg:#1e1e2e,spinner:#f5e0dc,hl:#f38ba8 \
+--color=fg:#cdd6f4,header:#f38ba8,info:#cba6f7,pointer:#f5e0dc \
+--color=marker:#b4befe,fg+:#cdd6f4,prompt:#cba6f7,hl+:#f38ba8 \
+--color=selected-bg:#45475a \
+--color=border:#6c7086,label:#cdd6f4"
diff --git a/system/install.sh b/system/install.sh
index e3209208..c4304a50 100755
--- a/system/install.sh
+++ b/system/install.sh
@@ -2,3 +2,13 @@
 
 # silence the login prompt
 touch "$HOME/.hushlogin"
+
+# btop: seed btop.conf if missing, then apply the active catppuccin flavor.
+script_dir="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
+btop_conf_dir="${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/btop"
+btop_conf="$btop_conf_dir/btop.conf"
+mkdir -p "$btop_conf_dir"
+if [ ! -f "$btop_conf" ]; then
+  btop --default-config > "$btop_conf"
+fi
+"$script_dir/../theme/bin/theme-sync-btop"

contextNote: Extends the catppuccin theme to bat, btop, fzf, lazygit, and yazi by adding a new theme/ dotfiles topic that applies the active flavor per tool.
originalBody:
Extends catppuccin (already on Ghostty/tmux/Neovim) to `bat`, `btop`, `fzf`, `lazygit`, and `yazi`. Moves the macOS appearance watcher into a `theme/` topic so any tool with runtime reload can flip flavors live. Drops `htop` for `btop`.

## Changes

### `theme/` topic (new)

Replaces `tmux/appearance/bin/_tmux-style-watch`:

- `theme/bin/watch-theme-change` (+ `_watch-theme-change.swift`): observes `AppleInterfaceThemeChangedNotification` and runs `theme-sync` on every flip.
- `theme/bin/theme-sync`: dispatcher that runs every `theme-sync-*` script.
- `theme/bin/theme-sync-tmux`: replaces `tmux-style-sync`/`tmux-style-check`. Self-gates on stale flavor.
- `theme/bin/theme-sync-btop`: rewrites `color_theme` in `btop.conf` and sends `SIGUSR2`.
- `theme/bin/theme-flavor`: outputs `mocha` or `latte` from `AppleInterfaceStyle`.

### Per-tool flavor application

| Tool | Mode | Mechanism |
|---|---|---|
| `bat` | live auto-flip | `--theme=auto:system` + `--theme-light="Catppuccin Latte"` / `--theme-dark="Catppuccin Mocha"` (built-in macOS detection in `bat` ≥ 0.25) |
| `btop` | live flip via watcher | `theme-sync-btop` patches `color_theme`, sends `SIGUSR2`. `btop`'s `Global::reload_conf` handler re-reads config + theme + banner. |
| `tmux` | live flip via watcher | unchanged behavior, migrated to `theme-sync-tmux` |
| `fzf` | pinned mocha | `FZF_DEFAULT_OPTS` in `system/fzf.zsh`. `fzf` reads env per invocation, so flipping doesn't update running shells. |
| `lazygit` | pinned mocha | `gui.theme` block in `git/lazygit.yml` (mauve accent). No live-reload upstream. |
| `yazi` | pinned mocha | `terminal/yazi-theme.toml` (mauve accent). No live-reload upstream. `syntect_theme` references `bat`'s mocha `.tmTheme` instead of duplicating. |

### Submodules

- `bat/catppuccin/` → catppuccin/bat
- `system/btop-catppuccin/` → catppuccin/btop

Both repos are mostly the `themes/` dir we use. `yazi` and `lazygit` upstreams pull megabytes of preview assets and 14+ accent variants per flavor; we use one accent each, so those stay vendored.

### Topic placement

- `lazygit` lives in `git/` (alongside `git`, `glab`, `diff-so-fancy`, `graphite`, `worktrunk`).
- `btop` lives in `system/` (alongside `fzf`, `hyperfine`, networking utilities).
- `yazi` returns to `terminal/` (alongside `ghostty`, `zoxide`, `iterm2`).
- `htop` removed from root `Brewfile`.

`theme/` is the only new topic. The watcher, dispatcher, and per-tool sync scripts form a cross-tool pipeline that doesn't fit anywhere else.

## Testing

- `prek` against changed files (`shellcheck`, `check-yaml`, `check-toml`, `trailing-whitespace`).
- `swiftc -typecheck` on the watcher.
- `install-symlinks` against an isolated `XDG_CONFIG_HOME`, including the case where `~/.config/{bat,btop}/themes/` already exists as an empty real dir (the pattern apps create on first launch).
- `theme-sync-btop` exercised against a copy of the live `btop.conf`: confirms the `color_theme` patch and the no-op self-gate on a second run.

I'll verify live after the post-merge sync, since the dev clone is separate from `~/.dotfiles`.
